description.zh:
集合名。

> 您可以通过[ListCollections](~~2401503~~)接口查看列表。
description.en:
The name of the collection.

>  You can call the [ListCollections](~~2401503~~) operation to query a list of collections.

description.zh:
实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID。
description.en:
The instance ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs.

description.zh:
具有rds_superuser权限的管理账号名称。

> 您可以通过控制台的**账号管理**创建账号，或者通过[CreateAccount](~~2361789~~)接口创建。
description.en:
The name of the manager account that has the rds_superuser permission.

>  You can create an account on the **Account Management** page of the AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL console or by calling the [CreateAccount](~~2361789~~) operation.
The password of the manager account.

description.zh:
命名空间，默认为public。

> 您可以通过[ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~)接口查看列表。
description.en:
The name of the namespace. Default value: public.

>  You can call the [ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~) operation to query a list of namespaces.
The region ID of the instance.

description.zh:
向量类型。取值说明：
- Dense（默认值）：稠密向量。
- Sparse：稀疏向量。
description.en:
The vector type. Valid values:

*   Dense (default)
*   Sparse

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb delete-vector-index --db-instance-id gp-bp152460513z0000 --collection document --manager-account testaccount --manager-account-password testpassword --namespace mynamespace --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --type Dense --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb DeleteVectorIndex --region cn-hangzhou --ManagerAccountPassword testpassword --Type Dense --DBInstanceId 'gp-bp152460513z0000' --ManagerAccount testaccount --Collection document --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Namespace mynamespace
